summary: Evaluated 17/17 result certification security checks. Result: PASS

checks.name: Compliant Result Certification
checks.description: Result satisfies all policy conditions and generates a VALID CERTIFIED Certificate.

checks.name: Independent Certificate Verification
checks.description: Verifies the unmodified certificate and registers a VALID status.

checks.name: Modified Result Tamper Detection
checks.description: Recomputing the result canonical representation post-issuance must fail.

checks.name: Modified Solver Inputs Detection
checks.description: Re-verifying certificate against altered solver inputHash must fail.

checks.name: Modified Solver Version Detection
checks.description: Validates that solver version changes must invalidate the certificate.

checks.name: Modified Verification Evidence Detection
checks.description: Detects if supporting physical evidence hash diverges post-issuance.

checks.name: Modified Attestation Detection
checks.description: Fails if the original cryptographically sealed attestation changes.

checks.name: Policy Change Detection
checks.description: Invalidates verification if governance policy is replaced or modified.

checks.name: Certificate Replay Attack Detection
checks.description: Prevents reusing/splicing a valid certificate onto a different result entity.

checks.name: Numerical Tolerance Enforcement
checks.description: Fails to certify if physics output violates tolerance boundaries specified by policy.

checks.name: Numerical Convergence Constraint
checks.description: Rejects result certification if the solver iteration failed to converge.

checks.name: Numerical Conservation Constraint
checks.description: Rejects result certification if basic physical conservation laws are violated.

checks.name: Numerical Stability Constraint
checks.description: Rejects result certification if the integration scheme reports solver instability.

checks.name: Enforce Required Elements Missing as UNPROVEN
checks.description: Policy-mandated numerical checks that are missing must output UNPROVEN status.

checks.name: Cryptographic Signature Tamper Detection
checks.description: Forced changes to the signature hex must fail cryptographic authentication.

checks.name: Revocation Protocol Enforcement
checks.description: Verifying a revoked certificate yields the REVOKED status and prevents false certification claims.

checks.name: Certificate Verification Reproducibility
checks.description: Validates that exporting/serialization does not affect deterministic verification result.
